prerequisites: None. Competences taught in the advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply computer science methods for the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstract thinking, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods in independently solving problems and communicating the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of Practical Computer Science

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and the solution of at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. The examination performance can be either a written exam or an individual oral examination.
